visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A female host with short hair and glasses, wearing a light-colored turtleneck, speaks directly to the camera in a professional studio setting. The background is softly blurred, showing a medical certificate and skincare products. Her expressions are lively and engaging as she addresses the audience. (2) The scene cuts to a product shot of a blue liquid bottle labeled "Blue Astringent Herbal Lotion" by Kiehl's against a white background. This visual serves as a reference for the skincare myth being discussed by the host in her narration. (3) Back to the host, she continues explaining skincare concepts. Bright blue text overlays and a small cartoon character at the bottom provide visual emphasis and a variety-show feel to the instructional content being presented. (4) A macro close-up reveals human skin with many small blackheads on the nose area. A white adhesive pore strip is shown being peeled back, lifting small white filaments from the pores. The camera captures the texture of both skin and strip. (5) An informative 3D animation illustrates the cross-section of a skin pore. It depicts the buildup of sebum and the formation of a blackhead, with labels pointing to "Oil" and "Whitehead," helping viewers understand the underlying biological process. (6) The camera returns to the host who lists various acids (Salicylic, Fruit, A-acid) through colorful floating text bubbles. She gestures with her hands while explaining the benefits of these chemical exfoliants over physical pore strips. (7) A static brand card appears at the end, displaying the "DRX Dermatology Clinic" logo along with contact numbers, social media handles, and location addresses in both Taipei and New Taipei City.

(2) A "ding" SFX occurs as a product image appears visually. The voice continues explaining usage steps. (3) A sharp "whoosh" SFX punctuates a transition to a skin macro shot. The voice becomes more emphatic, debunking myths about pore strips. (4) Multiple "click" or "pop" SFX sync with text appearing on screen. The BGM remains consistent in the background. (5) The speaker's tone shifts to instructional, recommending chemical exfoliants. Fast-paced delivery with rhythmic BGM accompaniment. (6) The audio ends with a brief melodic stinger that coincides with the final brand contact information card, bringing the fast-paced instructional narrative to a clean and professional close.

narrative_and_purpose.narrativeStructure: Linear: Hook -> Problem Analysis -> Solution -> CTA
narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: The video aims to educate viewers on why traditional nose pore strips and astringent lotions are ineffective for blackhead removal, subsequently promoting the use of specific chemical acids (like Salicylic acid) for better skin results, positioning the creator/brand as a professional skincare authority.
